items.comments:
Such a lovely home to stay at while exploring Seattle! We had a large group and there were plenty of very comfortable beds and towels for everyone. The host was very accommodating when it came to our arrival and departure schedule as well.

Finally, this house has so much character! There's an amazing entertainment room in the basement, a reading alcove in the attic, a dual rain shower, inspiring decor, and even a zen garden. We definitely hope to stay here again during our next Seattle visit :)

The place was very tidy and clean, it was perfect for the purposes of a business trip, there was three of us each with their own room and bathroom. The local bars in the area were very friendly and accommodating.
